nodes.message:
fix(config): return false on any stat error, not just missing

CheckFileExists and CheckPathExists only treated os.IsNotExist as absence
and then dereferenced the os.Stat info on every other error. At the root
of a linked worktree the ".git" fallback is a regular file, so
os.Stat(".git/glab-cli/config.yml") returns ENOTDIR, which os.IsNotExist
does not match. info is nil, info.IsDir() panics, and LocalConfigDir
crashes every glab command. The same happens on safe.directory /
dubious-ownership errors and when git is not on PATH.

Return false on any stat error in both helpers, so a non-missing error is
treated as "not present" instead of panicking. Add tests that stat through
a regular file (ENOTDIR on Linux/CI) to cover the nil-info path.

nodes.message:
test(config): disable commit signing in the worktree helper

newRepoWithWorktree makes a commit so the linked worktree has something
to check out. With commit.gpgsign set globally the helper inherits it
and git aborts with "signing failed: No secret key", failing every test
in the file for a reason unrelated to the config lookup under test.

configureGitConfig in internal/git already pins this alongside user.name
and user.email for the same reason. This package cannot import that one
without a cycle, so the setting is repeated here.
